messages:
deploy-bot: [PROMOTE BLOCKED] promote redwood/api@sha:0a1b2c3 -> registry failed: artifact upload timed out (3 retries). blocking release window. logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/1789

alex: saw it, thanks. which job failed exactly? deploy-bot, can you paste the task id?

deploy-bot: task: upload-artifact-1789, runner: selfhosted-12, err: PUT https://registry.internal/v2/blobs/uploads/: net/http: request canceled (client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)

maria: ugh, this started after the image size bump from the logging change in PR #3421. artifact is ~1.9GB now (was 1.1GB). upload times out on our lower-concurrency runners.

jon: is this strictly network/rate or the registry rejecting because of size? any 5xx from registry?

ci-bot: snippet from upload-artifact-1789:
```
Uploading layer 3/7 (1.9GB)...
PUT /v2/blobs/uploads/: 504 Gateway Timeout
retrying (1/3)
PUT /v2/blobs/uploads/: context deadline exceeded
```

erin: we've been seeing intermittent GCS backend throttling in eu-west region. large multipart uploads get slow and sometimes time out when concurrency is high. last week we increased runner concurrency from 4 -> 8 which probably exposed this.

alex: options: 1) revert PR #3421 and re-promote last-good image, 2) pin release to previous image hash and continue, 3) tweak upload job (reduce concurrency, longer timeouts) and re-run, 4) manual promote after forced reupload to alternate registry mirror.

maria: I can cut a small revert that removes the big logging blob (it's not needed in the release) — that would bring image back to ~1.1GB. Revert + rebuild + promote should be fastest to restore the release window.

jon: ok timeline? release window closes in ~2.5h. revert+ci rebuild usually ~35-45m, promote + canary another 20m. that fits if we start now.

erin: alternative quick mitigation: set UPLOAD_CONCURRENCY=2 and UPLOAD_TIMEOUT=30m in the upload job and re-run upload-artifact-1789. low risk but if registry continues to throttle may still fail.

alex: decision: do revert + rebuild as primary plan. if rebuild fails, fallback to altering upload job and re-running on mirror. maria, you own the revert. jon, you're on rebuild/promo. erin, prep the mirror + upload job change in case. I'll coordinate the release window and update release notes if we need to delay. :thumbsup:

maria: pushing revert branch now: `revert/3421-remove-large-blob` -> will open PR and request fast CI.

ci-bot: PR 3421-revert created: https://ci.internal/pr/4792 — triggered pipeline `build-image-4792`. status: queued.

jon: queued on selfhosted-5, estimating build ~28m. I'm watching.

ci-bot: build-image-4792: succeeded (image: redwood/api@sha:0a1b2c3-revert -> sha:7f8e9d). pushed to staging registry mirror.

deploy-bot: canary deploy redwood/api@sha:7f8e9d -> staging started. canary policy: 5% -> 25% over 10m.

erin: canary logs: canary passed perf checks but one e2e flake (search-autocomplete) intermittently failing in 1/12 runs. looks unrelated to revert.

alex: given flaky test, do we proceed with manual promote? We have time in window and the flake is non-blocking historically.

maria: I vote promote. we can add a post-release ticket to quarantine that e2e and add more retries.

jon: manual promote done: `promote --from=staging --to=prod --image=7f8e9d --force` — promote succeeded, deploybot report: promotion completed, release tagged `release/2026-03-21-rc3`. :rocket:

deploy-bot: note: previous failed artifact `sha:0a1b2c3` will be marked as bad and removed from promo candidates. archive created at `s3://releases/blocked/1769454321/`.

alex: summary: reverted PR #3421 to remove large blob, rebuilt image (sha:7f8e9d), canary pass, manual promote completed. release window preserved. follow-up: 1) maria to open a patch to reintroduce logging change with streaming layers (reduce layer size) 2) erin to add registry-mirror promote path + upload job tunables to docs 3) qa to triage flaky search-autocomplete e2e. Thanks everyone.

jon: leaving a quick release note blurb in the release thread. congrats team. :tada:
